paper_title: Correspondence Cognitive Learning for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification

primary_page.content_read: official title/authors/abstract/lay summary and available resource links

primary_abstract_paraphrase.problem: MLLM生成文本与图像的对应强度有差异，统一处理可能引入不合适的监督。

search_scope: Exact paper title searches on arXiv/PMLR/author homepage/GitHub; no accessible author full paper or training implementation obtained in this check.
inference_for_project: 当前TriFusion没有MLLM文本分支；该论文摘要针对图文对应噪声，不能据此声称本项目图像身份标签有噪声，或将其当作已验证的当前结构修复。
